title: Candy Sync encrypted tab delta v2
description: Workspace-scoped encrypted tab mutation. Routing metadata is authenticated as AES-GCM AAD; tab action and content remain inside ciphertext.

mutationId.description: Stable client-generated mutation identity used for cross-transport deduplication.

workspaceId.description: Claimed workspace. Server rejects any value not equal to bearer-authenticated workspace.

deviceId.description: Authenticated writer device. Server ignores no client override and rejects mismatches.

entityId.description: Target synced-profile device in same workspace.

revision.description: Server-assigned target-profile revision. Omitted from push; required in pull and realtime frames.
Non-negative signed 64-bit decimal encoded as a string.

nonce.description: Exactly 12 bytes encoded as unpadded base64url.

ciphertext.description: AES-256-GCM ciphertext including 16-byte tag, encoded as unpadded base64url.
